_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,649 stores in 50 states and Canada with 187 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,649 stores in 50 states and Canada with 187 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.74x; +23% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.96; conservative 2yr +6%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.9%/yr (worst year FY99-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-22.9%/yr (Q3 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.8%/yr (FY99-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +35.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY99-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2009-09-04) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.74x (49.1% downside to Bear $11 / +66.5% upside to Bull $36) | Adj composite 1.54 vs market 2.50: gap -0.96 [OVERVALUED] | +23% above the EPP floor $18 (15x FY09E $1.17) | Conservative 2-yr case: +6.3% total (+3.1%/yr) | At 18.5x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $29 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps -9.5% in Q2 FY09, forward sales -5% to -2% (Q3 FY09 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
